reviews.title: Instantly shadow banned.
reviews.text:
This app is a scam. I downloaded the app, logged in, and this app scanned my account for about 20 minutes before it said an unknown error caused it to fail. When I tried to log back in, I got a notification from IG stating they suspected suspicious activity on the account and warned against further use. I didn’t even use this app to make a change to my account before it was flagged. This app is 100% a scam and you’re risking your account status if you use it.

It has been 30 days since this happened, and my account is still shadowbanned and nobody that isn’t following me can see my content.

— update. The shadow ban has not lasted over 90 days and only my followers can see my posts. Today the developer reached out to me and asked for more information. They even offered me free subscription access. 

Yes, free access to the subscription service that caused a ban on my decade old account with 13k followers. 

Absolute nonsense. This app is a scam and should be removed from the App Store.
